title: EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.16523v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training LLM agents to interact with users over multiple turns is challenging because the learning signal depends not only on the agent, but also on the user simulator and environment, which jointly shape the agent's experience. Simulated users can be stochastic or inconsistent, while environments may contain unreliable tools, incomplete state coverage, and incorrect verifiers. Prior work mainly addresses the resulting instability through reward shaping or denser supervision, while treating these components as fixed. We instead introduce EAU, a meta-agent framework for environment--agent--user co-evolution. During training, EAU monitors trajectories, tool traces, rewards, and training statistics; diagnoses failures and uninformative interactions; and proposes targeted modifications to the user simulator, environment, reward design, and RL configuration. translated_title: EAU：用于训练以用户为中心的智能体的环境-智能体-用户协同进化框架
translated_abstract: 训练大语言模型（LLM）智能体与用户进行多轮交互是具有挑战性的，因为学习信号不仅取决于智能体本身，还取决于用户模拟器和环境，它们共同塑造了智能体的经验。模拟用户可能是随机或不一致的，而环境中可能包含不可靠的工具、不完整的状态覆盖以及不正确的验证器。先前的工作主要通过奖励塑形（reward shaping）或更密集的监督来解决由此产生的不稳定性，同时将这些组件视为固定不变的。我们转而提出EAU，一个用于环境-智能体-用户协同进化的元智能体（meta-agent）框架。在训练过程中，EAU监控轨迹、工具调用记录、奖励和训练统计数据；诊断失败和无信息量的交互；并对用户模拟器、环境、奖励设计和强化学习（RL）配置提出有针对性的修改。经过验证的更改会被热替换（hot-swap）到正在进行的训练运行中，从而使训练设置能够与智能体的发展共同演进。
tldr: EAU提出了一种元智能体框架，通过监控和诊断训练过程，对用户模拟器、环境、奖励设计和强化学习配置进行针对性修改并动态热替换，实现环境-智能体-用户的协同进化，从而提升以用户为中心的多轮交互智能体的训练效果。
en_tdlr: EAU is a meta-agent framework that enables environment-agent-user co-evolution by monitoring training trajectories, diagnosing failures, and dynamically hot-swapping validated modifications to the user simulator, environment, reward design, and RL configuration during training.
